messages:
Ivy: Heads-up: CI caught new typing failures in sample-app after autogen started emitting open enums as plain strings.
Jon: can you paste the mypy error?
Ivy: sure:
```
src/models/order.py:28: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type \"str | None\", variable has type \"OrderStatus | None\")  [assignment]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 8 source files)
```
Ken: That matches what I saw locally. We changed enum handling to avoid ValueError on unknown values, but we lost the enum type in the annotated signature.
Rina: From a runtime perspective keeping unknowns as raw strings is intentional, but static types should reflect both possibilities.
Jon: Agreed. Suggested generator output: `Optional[Union[OrderStatus, str]]` and a pydantic validator that tries `OrderStatus(v)` then falls back to the raw string. Keeps callers aware and typecheckers happy.
Ivy: Good idea. Two compatibility notes: avoid PEP 604 syntax to not require `from __future__ import annotations` for users on py3.8, and import `Union`/`Optional` in generated files when used.
Ken: Also update the generated-file header comment explaining why enums allow raw str for forward-compatibility with server changes. Helps downstream devs.
Jon: I'll draft a minimal generator patch that emits `Optional[Union[EnumName, str]]`, adds `@validator(..., pre=True)` to coerce, and includes the comment.
CI-bot: sample-app/mypy-check failed on branch enum-open-1970012345 — https://ci.internal/runs/5210 — logs attached.
Rina: Can we add a unit test that simulates receiving an unknown enum value like `DEPRECATED_STATUS` so we don't regress? We had a regression earlier where validator raised and crashed callers.
Jon: Yep. Test will assert the model preserves the raw string and that the annotated type is compatible in typing-checks.
Ken: One more thing: mention pyright in the PR description. They handle unions slightly differently and some customers run strict pyright configs.
Ivy: Good call. Also run the updated generator against quickstart and playground repos in a smoke job before rolling out.
Jon: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autogen/pull/4210 — includes generator change, updated sample-app test, and changelog entry.
CI-bot: PR 4210 CI: all checks passed and merged into main at 1970012430.
Ivy: Thanks! After merge I'll trigger the cross-repo smoke to be safe.
Ken: Resolving this thread on my end. :white_check_mark:
